title: Micro Assistant
description: Shows which counting relics and powers each card play affects - on the hovered card, and above the End Turn button.
changeNote: v0.11.0: badge scale slider (0.5-3.0) replaces Big and Bold; End Turn badges fade with the button between turns; Replace End Turn face is wider, wraps badges 4 per row, keeps the long-press bar visible, highlights on hover, and no longer swallows presses; turn tickers drop their redundant number; Ripple Basin/Orichalcum badge the Block they will grant; native slash roundel replaces the X; wide badge rows center; Hide Negated Payoffs switch; Replace Card Count defaults on.
